author: /root
purpose: Distinguish a charge-mean contribution to the V480 coordinate losses from shape residuals, finite-batch effects, and gradient competition without changing the live R63 recipe.

facts: q(v)=sum(v[100:400])-3*sum(v[0:100]); this is in code voltage-sample units, not the 1000*q mV ns reporting unit.
BoxChargeProjection enforces charge before canonical ADC within floating-point error.
canonical_adc_torch includes float32 conversion, clamp/round, and a second canonical-code reconstruction; ideal one-step rounding cannot silently replace this path.
The candidate is canonical_adc_torch(output, True) before feature extraction.
V480 is raw canonical voltage; U480 is baseline-subtracted own-peak normalized voltage with floor 0.0025, not a unit-charge waveform.
Each region shares the same REAL TRAIN coordinate center and positive scale between SOURCE and REAL.
Standardized coordinates are cast to float32 before empirical W1.
The V480 coordinate-mean part has coefficient 1/8 in full_window after averaging the four views and marginal/sliced terms.
coordinate_RMS is the Euclidean norm of the coordinate W1 vector divided by sqrt(dimension).
The V480 coordinate_RMS part has coefficient 1/4 before the original SOURCE regional mass.
config.json currently gives both full_window and coordinate_RMS outer weight 1.

mathematical_definition.scope: One fixed raw-input region and its actual normalized empirical SOURCE and REAL laws. Equal batch sizes are not necessary for the bound; each coordinate W1 must use the same within-law weights as the means.
mathematical_definition.Y_R: Y is canonical SOURCE output and R is canonical REAL reference. Values are interpreted as real numbers for this proof.
mathematical_definition.mu_s: The shared frozen regional V480 center mu_j and positive scale s_j.
mathematical_definition.z: zY_j=(Y_j-mu_j)/s_j and zR_j=(R_j-mu_j)/s_j in exact arithmetic.
mathematical_definition.represented_z: zbar is the actual float32 standardized coordinate. Its deviation from exact z includes all subtraction, division, and cast rounding, not only the final cast.
mathematical_definition.d_j: Exact empirical W1 between the represented zbarY_j and zbarR_j laws, before any floating-point error in sorting/subtraction/reduction is interpreted as an exact certificate.

proof: For any two scalar laws with finite first moments, abs(mean(A)-mean(B)) <= W1(A,B): take expectations under any coupling and apply abs(E(A-B)) <= E(abs(A-B)), then take the infimum.
The shared center cancels: E q(Y)-E q(R)=sum_j a_j*s_j*(E zY_j-E zR_j).
Insert represented zbar values, apply the triangle inequality and the previous scalar bound: Dout <= sum_j c_j*d_j + Erep.
Since d_j>=0, sum_j c_j*d_j <= max_j(c_j)*sum_j d_j = 480*max_j(c_j)*Lmean.
Cauchy-Schwarz gives sum_j c_j*d_j <= norm2(c)*norm2(d) = sqrt(480)*norm2(c)*LRMS.

result.optional_source_charge_form: Let Dsrc=abs(E_SOURCE q_source-E_REAL q(R)) and epsq=E_SOURCE abs(q(Y)-q_source), with the exact same SOURCE weights/parents. Then replace Dout-Erep by Dsrc-epsq-Erep in both lower bounds.
result.combined_R63_contribution: With original regional masses m_r and the verified unit outer weights, the two V480 terms alone are at least sum_r m_r*(LBmean_r/8 + LBRMS_r/4). Other nonnegative losses and views are retained, not subtracted or renormalized.
result.unit_consistency: If reported charge is 1000*q, all charge coefficients, gaps and charge errors must be scaled consistently. Mixing mV ns gaps with the unscaled code coefficients is invalid.

limits: No actual Dsrc, Dout, Erep, epsq or numerical bound was computed here. No positive unavoidable residual has been established for this project.

An output-specific bound is descriptive, not a uniform bound over all allowed neural outputs. A model-independent irreducibility claim would additionally require a valid uniform post-ADC charge-error and representation-error bound.

For a certified numerical result, all errors in means, empirical W1 reductions and the bound arithmetic need conservative treatment; a nominal float64 value is not automatically a mathematical certificate.
This only bounds the V480 coordinate contributions. It does not explain U480, DU479, D2U478, temporal structure, or all sliced losses.
A large loss contribution does not imply a large parameter gradient, gradient conflict, or ineffective training.
The bound depends only on a charge-mean difference and can be zero when charge laws differ substantially; zero does not establish compatibility.
No bound on the original A-F classifier/PSD/width acceptance follows from this training-objective bound.
No parent deletion, REAL reweighting, changed region boundary, loss subtraction or changed acceptance is authorized by this derivation.
conditional_future_use: If the fixed R63 result warrants another TRAIN-only diagnostic, its preregistered shared endpoint collection may include these scalar quantities and per-region counts alongside gradient and shape diagnostics. Freeze numerical treatment and output definitions before new scientific data processing; do not run the diagnostic during the live R63 job.
